remarks: Stately and sophisticated, this exceptional Colonial is ideally situated on one of the Buffalo's most distinguished streets. A grand center entrance and beautifully landscaped grounds create impressive curb appeal, while soaring 12-foot ceilings, refinished hardwood floors, and exquisite architectural details seamlessly blend timeless elegance with modern luxury. The gracious foyer features a striking chandelier and spectacular leaded-glass windows. French doors open to a refined living room with built-ins, gas fireplace, fresh paint, and inviting sitting area. The formal dining room showcases custom wallpaper, floor-to-ceiling windows, detailed wainscoting, and a statement decorative fireplace. Designed for both entertaining and everyday living, the chef’s kitchen features a Thermador range, imported tile flooring, soapstone countertops, generous breakfast bar, and gas fireplace. A sun-filled family room with a wall of windows overlooks the private backyard and opens to the deck and stone patio. A spacious laundry/mudroom with built-in storage and stylish powder room complete the first floor. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite offers an incredible custom walk-in closet and spa-inspired bath with double vanity, steam shower, and soaking tub. Two additional bedrooms, a full bath with vintage tile, and generous walk-in closet complete the second floor, along with a private balcony overlooking the grounds. The full walk-up attic offers exceptional potential with tall ceilings, cedar closet, and separate electrical panel. Updated mechanics include tankless hot water, two furnaces, and central air. Outside, the fully fenced grounds feature a beautiful stone patio and ample space for entertaining. An enviable location places you moments from Elmwood Village, the waterfront, AKG Museum, and the best of Buffalo’s dining, culture, and amenities. A truly distinguished residence where historic character and elevated modern living meet. Seller reserves right to set an offer deadline; highest and best offers only please -- no escalation clauses.
